name: Minimum
description: Modern optimization mod for Geometry Dash. Faster object processing, less lag on dense levels, smoother particles, and quality of life options. Sequel to Algebra Dash.

fast-pickup.name: Fast Pickup
fast-pickup.description: Faster item collection and counter updates. Helps when levels use many collectibles.

skip-static-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-static-batch.description: Skips draw calls for sprite batches with no quads. Reduces GPU work on busy levels.

cull-particles.name: Cull Offscreen Particles
cull-particles.description: Pauses particle systems that are far off screen. Cuts lag spikes from heavy particle spam.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skips saving when the game loses focus so alt tabbing feels instant.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Forces textures to load as RGBA8888 for sharper visuals. Windows only. Needs texture reload.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA level from 0 off to 4 for x16. Windows only. Needs restart.
